name: glance-scanner
description: Security scanner for AI agents. Static analysis by default (semgrep + npm audit), no API key. Optional AI semantic analysis on your own provider key.

scripts.test: node tools/provenance.js check && node tools/render-safety.js && node tests/validate.js && node tests/semgrep-skip.js && node tests/surfaces.js && node tests/secrets-gate.js && node tests/secret-shapes-reachability.js && node tests/discovery.js && node tests/render-safe.js && node tests/pipe.js && node tests/verdict.js && node tests/finding-paths.js && node tests/interpreter.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run check-dist:release

author: Golem Labs
